description: Homes for sale on capcenter.com in a city, county or ZIP code in a state CapCenter is licensed in, filtered by price, bedrooms, bathrooms and home type (up to 10). Returns the public listing facts (price, beds, baths, square feet, city, ZIP, photo, status), the capcenter.com listing link, the MLS attribution to show with each listing, a quote link with the price filled in and a link to meet a CapCenter Realty agent. Answers in Spanish with language=es (viviendas en venta).

city.description: City name, e.g. Richmond or Glen Allen. Give exactly one of city, county or zip.

county.description: County name, e.g. Henrico or Chesterfield County. Give exactly one of city, county or zip.

language.description: Response language: en (default) or es (Spanish). Legal disclosures stay in English verbatim, with a Spanish courtesy translation added.

limit.description: How many listings to return, 1 to 10 (default 5).

property_type.description: house, townhouse, condo, manufactured or land.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Only states CapCenter is licensed in are answered.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code. Give exactly one of city, county or zip.

name: search_homes_for_sale
title: Search homes for sale
